Here is a weapon that makes up for [[Leia's Sporting Blaster]]. Deploys free on [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]], targets for only 1 Force, and hits with some power at destiny +1. "If hit by [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]], target is lost." That means immediately! not just at the end of the battle. Now that's "sporting."

Combos:

Any version of [[Leia Organa{{!}}Leia]] + [[Leia's Blaster Rifle]] + [[Sorry About The Mess]]. She's always been good in a fight, now she can pick off two Dark Side characters before the end of the battle phase.
